text.card: A red giant 4,249 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.00 solar masses and 10.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,887 K at its surface.
